caption:
I just wanted to see what the archive held. Instead, the screen gave me a 'welcome' I didn't ask for. My head feels like it's been through a meat grinder, and for a second, I wasn't in a basement—I was somewhere else entirely. 

She lies on the cold concrete, gasping, as the phantom heat of a different world continues to burn behind her eyelids.

#NeoTokyo #ArchiveLogs #Subject01 #NeuralSync #GlitchInTheMemory ⚡️
